task.description:
WF-03 Step 2: Fix design artefact for GH-533 / ISS-0209.

Read ISS-0209-diagnosis.yaml.

Produce a fix design. Classify the fix per templates/lego-catalog.md:
- If the fix is a simple parameter change → templates/specs/<name>.yaml (Type A/C/E — see catalog)
- If it involves novel logic / synchronization / test harness changes → src/design/iss0209-test-api08-recovery.md (Type E prose per backend_developer_guide.md §6)

The design must:
- Cover every acceptance criterion from the diagnosis report
- Specify the exact synchronization mechanism (advisory lock? schema-per-worker isolation? serial provisioning queue?)
- List every file to be modified with line ranges and reason
- Specify what regression tests are required
- Error taxonomy if new error types introduced
- NO implementation code — design only (interfaces, signatures, data flow)

Add produced artefacts under artifacts_out in the result.
acceptance_criteria: Design file (yaml or md) exists under templates/specs/ or src/design/
Design covers all diagnosis acceptance criteria
No implementation code in the design
Files to modify listed with line ranges

result.summary: Design for ISS-0209 (test_api08_auth tenant_default DROP SCHEMA recovery race) — classification: Type E (novel test-harness synchronization logic).
